title: Integral condensed coefficient ring of a finite p-adic extension
statement:
For a prime $\ell$ and a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, let
$A_E=\underline{\mathcal O_E}$ be the commutative condensed ring on the coherent [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring]
pro-étale site of profinite sets, where $\mathcal O_E$ is the valuation ring selected by
the absolute value $|\cdot|_E$ of [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. In Lean this is
`integralModelCondensedCoefficients l E`, with its commutative ring-object instance.
